    Complete Timeline

    BGD ERA — Before the Great Divergence¶

    Date Event
    ~15,000 BGD
    ~15,000 BGD MELKOR island forms around the wreckage.
    ~15,000–14,000 BGD Age 0 — The Lost Era. Post-crash chaos. Survivors cling to the crash site; first dispersal begins.
    ~14,000–11,000 BGD Age 1 — Age of Nomadism. Survivors live as wanderers. No permanent settlements.
    ~10,999–9,000 BGD Age 2 — Age of First Tribes. Tribal societies form. Species begin differentiating by region.
    ~8,999–7,000 BGD Age 3 — Age of First Empires. First civilizations rise. Elvengar founded on Kutten — the first great elven kingdom.
    ~6,999–5,500 BGD Age 4 — Dragon Tyranny. Dragons rule 90% of Ge'or. Intense territorial warfare brings them to near-extinction.
    ~5,499–4,500 BGD Age 5 — Dwarf Era. Dwarves dominate through underground megacities fueled by Romanium. Economic collapse when Romanium runs out.
    ~4,499–2,989 BGD Age 6 — Iron/Elvish Age. Post-Romanium collapse. Dwarven economy in ruins. Elvengar rises. Ends with the Hybrian crash at Pontus.
    ~2989 BGD Hybrian Shadows arrive. Damaged vessel crashes in Pontus (eastern Erisdar). Shadows chose Pontus for its mountain-surrounded isolation. Begin hibernation.
    ~2989–1989 BGD Phase 1 of the Shadow Plan. First millennium: study Ge'or, create Homunculi, infiltrate institutions, build secret cult.
    ~1989–989 BGD Phase 2 of the Shadow Plan. Build global influence network. Engineer wars. Manipulate historical figures.
    ~1729 BGD Old Lumina Empire founded by the beastman Emperor Kaelor I. A great beastmen empire — will eventually control 70% of Lumina Continent, Cattos island, and parts of Tuba.
    ~1667 BGD Masaaki Sytrenis born — "Sytrenis the Diplomat," the catmen hero who will end the catmen extermination and the Termopolas threat (see Sytrenis).
    ~1645 BGD The Metrak Incident. At twenty-two, Masaaki Sytrenis and his party stop the waking Metrak, a mountain-sized war-mechanoid of the Last Great War hidden in the now-Munchon region. Emperor Atanides dies; Termopolas is ravaged; the Tunwif–Termopolas conflict follows, and "Sytrenis the Diplomat" ends the catmen persecution.
    ~1134 BGD Old Lumina Empire falls. Shadow operation: Luminous XII defeated by Goblin King (engineered). Brother Hoelio killed. Luminous XII commits suicide. Empire collapses. The beastmen — the empire's own people — slowly return to savagery, forgetting their old ways. Maomism rises among the survivors. Lumina enters a tribal dark age.
    ~989–421 BGD Phase 3 of the Shadow Plan. Target Baoth as pan-continental super-state. Infiltrate Baoth's upper echelons. Possess Goldenborn.
    ~526 BGD Kirivis receives the bright tablet. Begins 60 years of obsessive study.
    ~476 BGD Kirivis has an epiphany. Deciphers the tablet. Falls into deep depression. Spends 10 years planning, sending secret teams across Ge'or.
    ~466–421 BGD The Demonic War. Kirivis attacks Baoth without explanation. 45 years of war.
    421 BGD Baoth destroyed. Kirivis storms the dragon hall. Rulfred reveals himself as Shadow agent. Kirivis beheaded. Crowd cheers. Rulfred becomes king.
    421 BGD Nethra survives. Kirivis's adopted daughter, age 13, escapes.
    ~420 BGD Nethra's march. Gathers loyalists. Brother Maoth sacrificed holding the line. Nethra reaches Rulfred's throne room.
    ~420 BGD The Lyrical Forest prophecy. Lyrical Forest spirits give Nethra a modified Shadow device — "a gift from 3,000,000 years ago."
    ~420 BGD Nethra transformed. Device detonates in throne room. Nethra becomes a different type of Shadow. Baoth's ruins are final.
    ~419 BGD Ironcloak founded. Nethra secretly creates the order. Nethrian Revelation transcribed.
    ~400–200 BGD Erisian Church fabricated. Eris (homunculus) performs staged miracles. Gathers followers. Fakes deaths and resurrections.
    ~300–100 BGD Church Militant. Holy orders conquer lands. Force conversions. Pontificate of Eris founded as Shadow headquarters.
    ~200–0 BGD Crusades launched. Waves of holy war expand Church control.
    Pre-Year 0 Elvengar flourishes. The first great elven kingdom dominates Kutten. Elves are the dominant civilization.

    YEAR 0 — The Great Divergence¶

    Date Event
    Year 0 The Great Divergence. Formingar Ocean reactor malfunctions. The Groom vortex forms. Elvengar destroyed.
    Year 0 The Silver Bride ring — formed from destroyed third moon — becomes Ge'or's defining celestial feature.

    AGD ERA — After the Great Divergence¶

    Date Event
    1–100 AGD The Kutten Catastrophe. Toxic rains and poisoned air desertify Kutten. Elves flee in great diaspora.
    1–100 AGD Elven refugees found Luzia and Maemon on Merratodoni.
    27 AGD Erisian Empire founded. Kingdom of Shamaradan atoned by Eris. Renamed under Davos the Magnificent.
    ~50–100 AGD Kutten recolonization begins. Settlers from Erisdar and Demon Continent arrive.
    94 AGD Vennerian Trade Republic breaks from Erisian Empire. Independence purchased with wealth.
    122–130 AGD Northaxeland Crusades.
    137 AGD Great Elvish Persecution. Erisian church campaigns to eliminate elves. Shadow-engineered operation.
    158 AGD Anos Plutocracy founded. Kingdom of Tiphar collapses after Lima and Venner invade to rescue Princess Charlotte. Anos city breaks away.
    170–597 AGD Great Ascension of Trade. Maritime republics rise. Colonial networks expand.
    214–236 AGD
    ~227 AGD
    ~290 AGD
    322 AGD
    ~400–500 AGD
    ~466 AGD
    500s AGD
    524 AGD
    ~530 AGD Asatru Empire stabilizes after civil war. General Doma's successors consolidate the reduced empire.
    ~542 AGD Anos–Komme Agreement. After intense negotiations, Komme joins Anos in a pact to work together to liberate Taberis from Venner.
    544 AGD Venner invades Minir island. Conquers Neopao and Koln. Dukedam becomes forced puppet.
    557 AGD Hermes Kennensbach born.
    ~570 AGD Hermes becomes Emperor. Begins reform attempts. Fails. Empire continues to crack.
    ~575 AGD Current Gigas dog-god born. Telepathic canine, now 22 years old in 597 AGD.
    ~580–590 AGD Kentian Civil War begins. Rebels control northeast Kent.
    ~585 AGD Mann Order invaded by Erilian Federation. Tiaboria captured. Refugees flee to Fractured State of Erislod, forming New Mann.
    589 AGD Xikxia taken over. Zakarutian queen's sister exiled. Raises army of 8,000. Marches on Xikxia. Declares independence.
    589–597 AGD Zakarutia rebuilds fleet. Archaic navy modernizing for reconquest.
    597 AGD Rex Pollo IV elected in Vennerian Trade Republic.
    597 AGD The Protagonists born — Emrys Eisenheart and twin sister Ichi, and Lucien Mortvagn 12 km away. Black agent incarnates. Hope Goddess vision. Prophecy fulfilled.
    600 AGD
    602 AGD
    ~597 AGD South Sun Empire emperor compromised. Eunuch homunculi installed in court.
    597 AGD Present day — Age 11 (Great Divergence). 248 sovereign nations. The Shadows prepare Armageddon.

    THE AGES OF GE'OR¶

    Age Era Key Trait
    Age 0 ~15,000–14,000 BGD Lost Era (Crash) — post-crash chaos
    Age 1 ~14,000–11,000 BGD Nomadism — post-crash survival
    Age 2 10,999–9,000 BGD First Tribes
    Age 3 8,999–7,000 BGD First Empires — Elvengar founded
    Age 4 6,999–5,500 BGD Dragon Tyranny
    Age 5 5,499–4,500 BGD Dwarf Era — Romanium-fueled
    Age 6 4,499–2,989 BGD Iron/Elvish Age — ends at Hybrian crash
    Age 7 2,989–967 BGD Human Age — continent empires, countism
    Age 8 967–421 BGD Age of Baoth — surveillance state, Demonic War
    Age 9 421–300 BGD Lost Era — anarchy, Eris cult fabricated
    Age 10 300 BGD–Year 0 Erisian Era — Church ascendant
    Age 11 Year 0–610 AGD Great Divergence — current era
    Age 12 After 610 AGD Age of Strife — to be written

    THE SHADOW PLAN — Phase Timeline¶

    Phase Date Range Activity
    Phase 1 ~2989–1989 BGD Infiltration — study, create homunculi, seed institutions
    Phase 2 ~1989–989 BGD Fragmentation — global network, engineered wars, Lumina fall
    Phase 3 ~989–421 BGD Consolidation — Baoth as super-state. Failed. Church launched as backup.
    Phase 4 ~421 BGD–present Current — rebuilding after Baoth. Armageddon imminent.
